dexes.name: Galar Pokedex
id_interpretation_notes: The user confirmed these numbers were read directly from their Pokemon Shield Galar Pokedex and represent all caught IDs they named.
The user considers the spoken ID list almost accurate; any difference from the game's 61-caught counter should be treated as a transcription/range-parsing issue, not as five invented missing Pokemon.
Explicit spoken ranges using 'to' were expanded, such as 4 to 6, 10 to 12, 29 to 31, 34 to 35, 42 to 43, 45 to 46, 70 to 71, 144 to 145, 161 to 162, 164 to 166, and 399 to 400.
Spoken dash-like pauses without the word 'to' were treated as separate IDs, such as 215, 222, 227, 230, 246, and 265.
The user corrected a spoken 96 to 98; only 98 is stored.
The spoken value between 119 and 144 is currently transcribed as 136 because the sequence was otherwise ascending; preserve this as a transcription detail until independently confirmed.

combined_reported_counters.notes: These totals are arithmetic sums of the three in-game Pokedex counters. They are not labeled as unique species because regional/DLC Pokedexes can overlap.

source: User-reported live Pokemon Shield Pokedex counters and caught Galar Dex numbers read directly from the in-game Pokedex
